assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website hero photography for a local Swedish cleaning and minor renovation company in Örebro, a generic mood image.
Primary request: a beautiful contemporary, believable attainable renovated Swedish apartment in soft morning light, pale oak parquet, quiet off-white plaster walls, generous windows, a carefully placed wooden dining table with wooden chairs, pale blue upholstered seating, one green plant.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 16:9, 2048 pixels wide. View from a clean hallway into the living and dining room. The left 45 percent of the frame is a naturally darker shaded wall and quiet furniture silhouette, calm visual space suitable for a white headline overlaid later. The right side opens into a bright, airy, naturally lit interior with authentic architectural depth.
Style/medium: high-end editorial architectural photograph, realistic wood grain and plaster, natural soft cool neutral tones, restrained Nordic taste. Elegantly lived-in yet spotless.
Constraints: no people, no text, no logo, no branding, no watermark, no moving boxes, no clutter. Not a luxury mansion. This is a generic inspiration interior, not a claimed real client project.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website service photography, a generic mood image for window cleaning in a Swedish apartment.
Primary request: a close editorial photograph of one anatomically accurate gloved human hand carefully pulling a professional plain unbranded squeegee across a large bright Swedish apartment window. The hand wears a simple cleaning glove and has a blue-grey work sleeve; the face and body remain out of frame.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3, 2048 pixels wide, close crop on the hand, tool, and glass. The rest of the tasteful pale oak and off-white apartment is softly out of focus.
Style/medium: high-end natural editorial photography, realistic fine water beads and freshly cleared glass, quietly authentic careful work, soft cool neutral tones and natural daylight.
Constraints: correct hand anatomy and believable grip, no face, no recognizable employee, no text, no logos, no branding, no watermark. Generic inspiration photograph; not a claimed company employee or completed project.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: editorial website service photography, a generic mood image for minor interior renovation.
Primary request: a close editorial photograph of one anatomically accurate human hand holding a plain unbranded paint roller and rolling warm very light grey paint onto an interior wall. Clean straight masking tape at the base and pale oak floor are visible below. Only a hand and forearm in plain blue-grey work clothing are seen, with no face.
Composition/framing: landscape 4:3, 2048 pixels wide, close view of the roller making a natural wet paint swath on the matte wall; keep the hand, roller and wall physically coherent.
Style/medium: high-end editorial photography, natural daylight, authentic understated Nordic apartment, realistic paint texture and wood grain, soft neutral natural cool palette.
Constraints: correct human hand anatomy and believable grip, no text, no logos, no branding, no watermark, no recognizable company employee. This is generic inspiration, not a claimed actual completed client project.
